subject: Renewal: EU residency + APAC rollout during contract renewal
messages:
From: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@medivent.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jul 2028 08:23:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal: EU residency + APAC rollout requests

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

We're starting the renewal conversation for our Redwood contract (term ends 2028-08-31). Two items have bubbled up that we need aligned before moving to signature: 1) EU data residency for all production workloads (GDPR compliance + vendor approvals) and 2) APAC burst capacity for Q4 pilot (Singapore region) with cross-region failover to EU in case of regional outage.

High level asks:
- Confirm whether EU residency can be delivered as a paid add-on during renewal and an estimate of timeline (we'd like a pilot by 2028-10-01).
- Capacity guidance: we expect initial APAC burst of ~50 concurrent vCPU-equivalents / 2k reqs/min and potential to scale to 200 concurrent in 2029.
- Any changes to standard term or SLA credits when adding cross-region failover? Our legal/ procurement teams will want to know.

I've attached a short internal note outlining our timeline and compliance questions.

Thanks,
Luca
Head of Platform, Medivent Health
Attachment: medivent-intent-2028-07-15.pdf
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@medivent.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: EU residency + APAC rollout requests

Hi Luca — thanks for the clear note and timelines. We're able to support EU residency as an add-on during renewal and can run an APAC burst pool for the pilot with a dedicated on-demand pool. A few immediate items so we can scope:

- Proposed pilot scope: EU production tenancy + single APAC burst pool (Singapore) for Q4 pilot.
- Timeline: onboarding + compliance checks typically 6–8 weeks from order; pilot by 2028-10-01 is feasible if we start procurement/contracting this month.
- SLA/terms: cross-region failover is supported; we typically add a Failover Addendum with a small premium and an operational runbook. SLA credits do not change, but the addendum documents responsibilities and failover sequencing.

I've attached a draft amendment (redwood-amendment-v1.pdf) with a capacity estimate and a first-pass SOW. Can we set up a 30-min call Wed 07/18 to walk the legal/procurement team through options?

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal: EU residency + APAC rollout requests (technical notes)

Internal: technical runbook notes for the SOW and pilot.

Quick bullets:
- EU residency model: we can provision a dedicated tenancy in eu-west-1 with customer-managed VPC peering. Data-at-rest KMS keys can be customer-managed (BYOK). Expect provisioning lead time 2–3 weeks once billing/contracting is complete.
- APAC burst: recommend a dedicated burst pool in ap-southeast-1 with autoscaling spikes enabled. For the volumes you mentioned, start with 4xA10G equivalent nodes (est cost baseline in amendment).
- Cross-region failover: we will route by policy — primary region EU; failover to APAC only on health checks beyond X minutes. Note: failover will increase token cost and may impact latency; include explicit fallbacks in the client's runbook.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence is available; we'll package data flow diagrams + retention policy for legal.

I'll sync with Product to confirm quantization/ batching choices for APAC to keep costs down.

— Vivek
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

2) SLA credits: is there any change to the SLA credit calculation when failover is enabled? We need the explicit clause for our legal team.
3) Data locality audit: can you provide a short evidence pack (diagram + SOC2 artifact) to our security mailbox?

Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: EU residency + APAC rollout requests — answers and next steps

Hi Anika / Team — thanks for the questions. Short answers and next steps below:

1) Term/Price: Residency pricing is available on 12- or 24-month terms. To keep list pricing flat we usually recommend a 24-month commitment for residency + multi-region failover; however, we can offer a pro-rated residency add-on on a 12-month renewal with a modest premium (see SOW-amendment-v2.pdf).

2) SLA credits: The baseline SLA remains unchanged. The Failover Addendum formalizes sequencing, runbooks, and responsibilities; SLA credit calculations are unchanged but we add an operational performance matrix for failover scenarios.

3) Data locality audit: attaching a short evidence pack and the updated SOW (SOW-amendment-v2.pdf). We will send SOC2 artifacts and data flow diagram to your security mailbox (security@medivent.com) today.

Action items:
- I will upload the SOW-amendment-v2 to DocuSign and share a link by EOD Monday 2028-07-22.
- Technical kickoff (onboarding) tentatively 2028-08-05 to meet pilot by 2028-10-01.
- Pricing note: expect a formal quote in HubSpot, deal RDW-2028-051.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/medivent-renewal
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ RDW-2028-051

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
